brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Four full bases: pair 1 at 0,0,0 + 1,0,0 and pair 2 at 0,1,0 + 1,1,0

requirements.requirement: Pairs joined to each other only with side connectors (no other joining method)
requirements.evidence: Connectors: connector:0#0,0|1,0 within pair1, connector:0#0,1|1,1 within pair2, and inter-pair connectors connector:0#0,0|0,1 and connector:0#1,0|1,1 joining the pairs. No joint bolts, no other hardware. House-rule lockJoints omitted to preserve 'only side connectors'.

finish.summary: Built 2x2 block of four full bases as two pairs (0,0-1,0 and 0,1-1,1). Intra-pair and inter-pair connections are all side-connector-double parts. No bolts or other joining. Skipped lockJoints/capOpenFaces to keep 'only side connectors' intact.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
